state.task: Log in to the admin backend at /index.php/login as administrator with password administrator, open the customers page, and report the name of the registered customer.

actions.description: Read-only: answer questions about Riverside Wellness Studio from the site's own content — offered services (with prices and durations), providers, business hours, booking/cancellation policies and contact details. Returns matching content sections plus source URLs; compose the answer from them. Use for any "what/when/who/how" question about this business.

query.description: The visitor question, in natural language.

actions.description: Read-only: list every bookable service with id, duration, price, location, description and the providers who offer it. Use the returned service id (and provider id) with check_availability and book_appointment.

Sign in to the back office with a username and password. The back-office tools (list_customers) are not registered until this succeeds, so call it first when the task needs staff-side data; then re-list the tools to see what became available.

Read-only: fetch the real open appointment slots for a service on one or more days (same source as the visible calendar). Times are in the business-local time zone, 24h "HH:mm", and are directly bookable via book_appointment. The visible wizard calendar is updated to the queried service/provider/date so the user sees the same slots.

service_id.description: Service id or exact name (see list_services). Defaults to the service selected in the wizard.

provider_id.description: Provider id or full name. Defaults to the wizard selection or the only provider of the service.

date.description: First day to check, "YYYY-MM-DD". Defaults to today.

days.description: Number of consecutive days to check (1-7, default 1).

actions.description: CREATES a real appointment at this business as soon as it is called — do not call until the user has confirmed service, time and contact details. Requires an open slot from check_availability ("date" + business-local "time"). On success the visible wizard reflects the selection, the page navigates to the booking confirmation screen, and the response includes the appointment id plus the personal manage/cancel link (which the site also emails to the customer when email notifications are enabled). If the slot was just taken, the response lists the remaining open slots.

service_id.description: Service id or exact name (see list_services).

provider_id.description: Provider id or full name. Defaults to the only/selected provider of the service.

email.description: Customer email — receives the confirmation and manage link.

actions.description: PERMANENTLY cancels an existing appointment as soon as it is called — only call after the user explicitly confirms. Requires the appointment_reference token from the customer's confirmation email (the site's own manage-link key); it cannot be guessed or looked up by email address. The appointment is first verified; if it exists and is still cancellable it is cancelled and the site's own cancellation confirmation screen is shown. The outcome is awaited, so a failed request is reported as a failure and nothing is changed. Cancellation is not reversible.

reason.description: Cancellation reason to record for the business (required by the site).

appointment_reference.description: The appointment reference from the confirmation email/manage link (the token after "booking/reschedule/").

actions.description: The task is complete. Report an answer supported by the observations.
